answer.text: Gives investor the right to sell back to issuer at specified price
Is the same as a convertible

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Putable gives the holder an option to sell back — pro-investor. **The Trap:** Convertibles are equity-linked; coupons exist. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in IV. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Putables are useful when yields may rise — investor can redeem and reinvest higher.
